description:
Advances: specled.append_only

Severity: Medium. @finding_codes MapSet.new(@emitted_finding_codes) is read at lib/specled_ex/append_only.ex:813, after the current call sites. Module attribute reads snapshot at the read point, so a finding/2 call in a function defined below that line emits at runtime and is silently absent from finding_codes/0.

Proven by execution: adding a probe emitter below :813 gives COUNT=12 HAS_PROBE=false. test/specled_ex/branch_check/severity_integration_test.exs is blind, and test/specled_ex/review/html_test.exs became blind on this branch when EmitterCodes stopped doing its own source regex and started delegating to finding_codes/0. test/docs_identifier_lint_test.exs still catches it (missing from @known_codes), so it fails closed today — one independent witness, not zero.

Why not on the release branch: the fix is a @before_compile restructure of a module four tickets contended over during the epic, and the gate currently fails closed. Two independent reviewers found it (idioms M1, security L2).

Source: 2026-08-12 critical review.
title: @finding_codes freezes mid-module; a finding/2 call below :813 never reaches the catalog
